text:
HTTP::close
Description
Closes the HTTP connection.
Syntax
HTTP
::
close
HTTP::close
Closes the HTTP connection. In a RESPONSE event, also inserts a
Connection: Close
header. Note that
OneConnect
transformations, if enabled, may modify the inserted header, but the
connection will still close.
Examples
when
HTTP_REQUEST
{
set
method
[
HTTP
::
method
]
}
when
HTTP_RESPONSE
{
# The current connection will close after a POST reply
if
{
$method
eq
"POST"
}
{
HTTP
::
close
}
}
Related Information
Valid Events:
CACHE_REQUEST
,
CACHE_RESPONSE
,
HTTP_REQUEST
,
HTTP_REQUEST_DATA
,
HTTP_REQUEST_SEND
,
HTTP_RESPONSE
,
HTTP_RESPONSE_CONTINUE
,
HTTP_RESPONSE_DATA
